P01.rationale: No dominant founder/person portrait anchors the page; the client photo in the right column is a group shot at moderate size, not a large hero portrait.

P05.rationale: The right column shows a clearly framed, named client portrait (two people from Frese Recruiting) at a meaningful size occupying roughly a quarter of the column, with name and company label beneath.

P07.rationale: There is no press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus beyond a single inline quote block, which does not constitute a social-proof system.

P10.rationale: A faint ghost numeral '3' appears in the upper-right area of the left column, but it is very subtle and small, not a strongly oversized decorative typographic element; the quote glyph is present but modest.

P11.rationale: Three bold metric callouts (24h→minutes, thousands of chats, 0 new staff) function as before/after data points but are presented as typographic statements rather than true data visualisations or charts.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably well-filled with structured text sections, metric callouts, a portrait, and a testimonial, giving a competent editorial feel, though the lower-left area has noticeable empty space.

P13.rationale: The dark right-column panel provides some atmospheric contrast, but the left column is essentially flat white with no texture or background treatment.

P14.rationale: The client photo sits in its own contained box without text overlaid on it, so readability is not compromised; no full-bleed photo with scrim is used.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) is present anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a real, specific business photo (two identifiable people with branded backdrop), reducing generic stock feel, though the setting is fairly plain.

N08.rationale: The lower-left quadrant of the page is largely empty after the 'Ergebnis' section ends, leaving a significant dead-white region that is not purposefully used.

N10.rationale: No text is placed directly over a busy photo; the portrait and text regions are cleanly separated into distinct layout zones.
